title: Programme Terms: Repair Programme Uplift on Rental Vehicle Coordination Delay Goodwill
content:
**Programme term.** The program uplift on the delay goodwill credit of a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental follows the discount program on the customer-pay repair order under Customer-Pay Repairs: a military program takes the repair tier's military discount percent; a returning-customer program takes the repair tier's returning-customer discount percent; any other program takes zero. The uplift raises the credit by that percent: the credit worked out from the credited delay days, their value and the goodwill share is multiplied by one hundred plus the uplift and divided by one hundred, and the limits on the credit apply to the uplifted figure.

## Programme table

| Discount program on the customer-pay repair order | Program uplift |
|---|---|
| Military | The military discount percent of the repair's service tier under Customer-Pay Repairs |
| Returning customer | The returning-customer discount percent of the repair's service tier under Customer-Pay Repairs |
| Any other program, or none | Zero |

## Basis Q&A

**Whose percentages are used?** Those of the service tier of the customer-pay repair order the rental is tied to.

**Hypothetical:** with a military discount percent of 8 in the repair's service tier, a credit of 35.00 USD before the uplift becomes 35.00 USD multiplied by 108 and divided by one hundred, 37.80 USD, before the limits on the credit are applied; with no program it stays 35.00 USD.
